verdicts.notes: Inheritance is right: all draws go through the painter graf; the bl sites 0x8000B06C/0x8000BA30 → 0x802CDD14 were checked in disasm. The ortho numbers are wrong, though. setOrtho(x,y,w,h) is the inline in J2DOrthoGraph.h:22-23, so the box it builds is (x, y, x+w, y+h). The DOL feeds setOrtho(TBox2&) the words 0x803F7D68=-9, 0x803F7D60=-21, 0x803F7D6C=650, 0x803F7D64=503 (stfs at 0x8000B03C..0x8000B058; the same loads before 0x8000BA30). So the box is -9..650 x -21..503, centre (320.5, 241), half-width 329.5, not -9..659 / centre 325 / 334. The EFB numbers survive: the edge shift is 320(F-1)/F = 80 EFB px at 16:9, and the scissor centre is EFB 320. The game-unit numbers change. The Gecko description is also wrong. Gecko does not widen the 2D 'another way': its writes 04 @803F7D68=-123 and 04 @803F7D6C=766 rewrite exactly the painter's setOrtho box words, which is the same mechanism this plan uses. Those words are shared with setUpRectangle (0x8000A6A8..B4, the photo freeze-frame). dOvlpFd2::draw also re-calls setOrtho at 0x80223CF4 with private copies (0x803FB734..40 = -9,-21,650,503) and so resets the graf ortho to 4:3 mid-frame. The 2D agent must cover both.

Every edge-anchor shift in this area is (-9 - L') = 329.5(F-1) game units (109.8 at 16:9), equal to 80 EFB px.
corrected.gecko: Gecko widens the same painter ortho by rewriting its .sdata2 box words: 0x803F7D68 -9→-123 and 0x803F7D6C 650→766, giving -123..766, ×1.349. Its `li r4,0` patches (0x80234528 opening, 0x8018F5CC gameover) pass NULL so J2DScreen::draw makes its own J2DOrthoGraph(0,0,640,480) (J2DScreen.cpp:150-157), i.e. draws that screen unwidened and therefore stretched.

verdicts.notes:
Confirmed: 0x802D09DC is `bl 0x802D0CE0`, and a DOL bl-scan finds that site as the only caller. getGlbResource `bl 0x802B68F0` sits at 0x802D0968 with r3 = name. J2DPane offsets match the decomp: +0x04 mMagic, +0x08 mTag, +0x0C mBounds, +0xA9 m2DBasePosition, +0xB0 JSUTree (JSUPtrList head/tail/len = +0xB0/+0xB4/+0xB8; link = obj, list, prev, next). J2DPane::setBasePosition 0x802D0800 recomputes the pivot and calls calcMtx. I re-ran the full-cover childless PIC1 scan over the finder's dump and got exactly the listed panes plus the BACK pictures. There are no full-cover PIC1/WIN1 containers, so the childless rule misses nothing. Ordering is guaranteed, not just observed: fopMsgM_setPaneData(…, scrn, tag) calls scrn->search(), which can only succeed after set().

Corrections:
(1) Use centre 320.5, not 325, in the widening formula.
(2) The Orig copy is fopMsgM_pane_parts_set, f_op_msg_mng.cpp:9790-9806 (lines 9814-9828 are the setPaneData wrappers).
(3) The DOL has 57 bl callers of 0x802D0944, not 60 (REL callers excluded).
(4) 0x8019E66C and 0x801CC208 are `stb r0,0x9A5(rX)` (direct mNowAlpha writes), not `bl setNowAlpha`.
(5) setBasePosition also forces mRotationAxis='z' (J2DPane.cpp:279). This is harmless here: every matched pane has rot=0.
(6) fd2l (f_map, note_02.bti) is vis=0 and never referenced by tag in d_menu_fmap.cpp, so widening it is harmless.
(7) operate_wind/operate_wind_mask 'BACK' (back_aori.bti) also matches.
(8) 'Textures exist nowhere on disc' for the BACK panes is unverified by me. It is harmless either way: drawSelf returns on a NULL texture (J2DPicture.cpp:233), and a textured BACK would be widened correctly.
d_menu_item reparents 'blak' with insertChild under ROOT (d_menu_item.cpp:86, :1006). ROOT is at the origin, so this is z-order only and the load-time widening stays valid. Only auction1 sets mbClipToParent in this area, so widened panes are not clipped back to ROOT anywhere else.

corrected.fix: T2 core hook: proj.hook_branchlink("j2d_screen_set_hook", 0x802D09DC). Body: ok = J2DScreen_set_stream(scr, stream); if (ok && mode==2) walk(scr,0,0); return ok. The walk is as the finder describes, with c = 320.5 (= (L+R)/2 of the painter box): x0' = c-(c-cx0)*F - ax, x1' = c+(cx1-c)*F - ax. Then call setBasePosition(p, p->m2DBasePosition) (0x802D0800). Match only childless PIC1 with cx0<=0, cx1>=640, cy0<=0, cy1>=480, and never touch PAN1. Optional file-name stash: hook_branchlink at 0x802D0968 (bl getGlbResource, r3=name).

Two are `stb r0,0x9A5(rX)` mNowAlpha writes: 0x8019E66C (collect m970) and 0x801CC208 (item +0x970). Rule A makes all of them unnecessary.

verdicts.notes: I reworked PaneScaleAlphaWipe (d_menu_save.cpp:1750-1797) at scale 1, with wp00=254x254 at (66,240). wp04 → rel (508,-254), matching the .blo. wp05 → (-78,-254), matching. wp06 → rel x -(254+78) = -332 (abs -266..399, y -27..-14). wp07 → rel y 254+15 = 269 (abs y 509..524). So once the wipe runs, the decomp leaves wp06 covering only -266..399 of a strip that sits almost entirely above the ortho top (-21), and puts wp07 entirely below the ortho bottom (503). Vanilla therefore already leaves the 494..503 bottom rows and the right part of the -21..-14 top rows uncovered. Only wp04/wp05 (y -14..494) matter for the side bands. With Rule B, PaneScaleAlphaWipe's resize and move from the widened mSizeOrig keep wp05 extending left from the iris and wp04 extending right, as the finder says. wp06/wp07 get shifted further left by the wider wp05.w, which changes nothing visible. In d_scope's wipe_00 and the picture box's wipe_00_2, wp04-07 really are the four full bars, and the per-edge rule handles them correctly there. The finder's centre must be 320.5. Medium confidence stays because of the vanilla corner gaps; a live look is needed.

corrected.fix: In the same walk: for tags {'wp04','wp05','wp06','wp07','mak1','mak2'} on childless PIC1, push each edge that touches the 4:3 edge to the real edge: if cx0<=0, x0' = 320.5-(320.5-cx0)F - ax; if cx1>=640, x1' = 320.5+(cx1-320.5)F - ax. Then call setBasePosition. For the save iris only the width change of wp04/wp05 matters, because move() recomputes their x each frame. wp06/wp07 are off-screen after the first wipe frame (decomp positions) and may be skipped. Fallback is the same as before: NOP `bl 0x8003BE30` at 0x801DAA38.
corrected.effect_native: Save iris: without Rule B the black frame stops at the 4:3 edges and bright side bands show beside the vignette. With Rule B, wp04/wp05 fill the bands for y -14..494. The thin top (-21..-14) and bottom (494..503) strips are uncovered exactly as in vanilla. Opening: the 4:3 bars are invisible over the black clear colour (g_clearColor 0x803F61A0 = 0).

Disasm matches. At 0x801DF9E0-0x801DFA04: viewport W/H, fdivs, lfs g_HIO+0xC (0x803B9A08), fmuls, then `bl 0x8030DB78` C_MTXPerspective at 0x801DFA04 (fov 30). l_HIO = 0x803E5EB4. The ctor 0x8019940C does __construct_array(this+8, size 0x58, n 3), so child 0's scale is at +0xC/+0x10 = 0x803E5EC0/C4 and child 2 (CLOTH_ONLY)'s at +0xBC = 0x803E5F70/74. The ctor stores 1.78 from 0x803FAC68 (=0x3FE3D70A). cloth_init copies HIO_CHILD.scale for DEFAULT and CLOTH_ONLY only, and hard-codes FILE_SELECT (d_menu_cloth.cpp:227-230). The mesh is at z=-6200: transS(pos.z-3800 = -6200), and transM(0,0,3400) cancels the vertex z of -3400 (d_menu_cloth.cpp:841). The plan's §9 picks g_HIO as the mode-2 knob, so this fix is needed by default. The coverage numbers are a geometric approximation (waves, the (10,40) centre offset and the mesh's exact x extent are ignored). Vanilla is already marginal: inradius 2670 vs corner radius 2698.6, so k(F)=1.218 keeps the same margin. Confirm live.

missed.effect_native: Under the g_HIO knob (culling plan §9) the card's projection widens by F. The captured full-EFB (anamorphic) frame is drawn into only the centre 1/F of the EFB, so during the transition the picture appears squeezed horizontally by F with black side bands. The plan's §9 lists this fade as 'widened' as if that were a benefit; it is a defect. The trailing setOrtho also resets the painter graf to the 4:3 box, so later 2D in that frame is uncompressed. That part is the 2D agent's.

It is a private .sdata2 literal with one load (0x802239F4), and lfs reads RAM, so there is no JIT issue. Hook option: hook_branchlink at 0x80223A10 calling C_MTXPerspective(m, f1, f2/F, f3, f4). The 2D agent must also handle the setOrtho at 0x80223CF4 the same way as the painter sites.
